description: Check prices and licence fit for a small, hand-checked set of sound effect packs: UI clicks and snaps, motion-graphics sounds, desert wind and train ambiences, and a kettle whistle, from SoundMorph, HISSandaROAR and Thomas Rex Beverly Audio (8 packs). Use this when the user wants sound effects for an app, game, video or interface and asks what a pack costs or whether its licence allows their use: commercial work, number of seats, AI training or generation, reselling the sounds, or a product where the sounds are a large share. Returns each pack’s price, whether it fits (eligible, conditional or not eligible) and which licence points still need the seller’s confirmation. It covers only these packs, not whole sound libraries; say so if none fits. Published prices; nothing is bought.

ai_use.description: Will the audio itself be used to train or generate with AI? (Asking an AI chat for prices is not AI use.) Default false.

commercial_use.description: Will the sounds be used in commercial work? Default true.

goal.description: How to rank: lowest_cash_now = least money to pay now for whole packs or plans; lowest_job_cost = lowest cost allocated to this job (leftover credits keep their value); best_requirement_fit = best match to the stated use first.

intent.description: What the sounds are for: ui (interface clicks, snaps), motion (motion graphics), nature (ambiences such as wind), train, kettle, or any.

lang.description: Language of the Formquote page linked in the answer (en, zh, ja, fr, de). The figures are the same; notes recorded by Formquote stay in their original language (mostly Chinese).

pure_sfx_percent.description: Optional: the share (0–100) of the finished product’s total duration that is this supplier’s sound effects alone, with no voice or music. Some licences restrict products where it reaches 25%.

seats.description: People or workstations that will use the sounds (default 1).

standalone_resale.description: Will the sounds be resold or redistributed on their own (as a sound pack)? Default false.
